caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest or trunk with a flat lid, shown in three-quarter view from the front right side. The chest is rendered in light brown tones, with subtle shading to indicate depth and dimension. The front and sides each have a recessed panel, while the chest rests on a base with short, slightly curved bracket feet. The surface of the chest is smooth, and a small keyhole is visible on the front beneath the lid. The chest is centrally positioned on a plain, off-white or beige background with no other objects present. There is a small, neat handwritten signature near the lower right corner of the image.
title: Chest
